mn36:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.

mn36:3.1: atha kho saccako niganthaputto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā tenupasaṅkami.
mn36:3.2: addasā kho āyasmā ānando saccakaṃ niganthaputtaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ

mn36:3.8: atha kho saccako niganthaputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saccako niganthaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn36:4.1: santi bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāyabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti no cittabhāvanaṃ.

mn36:4.7: santi pana bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā cittabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti no kāyabhāvanaṃ.
mn36:4.8: phusanti hi bho gotama cittacetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ.

mn36:5.3: nando vaccho kiso saṅkicco makkhali gosālo

mn36:5.6: te ekāgārikā vā honti ekālopikā dvāgārikā vā honti dvālopikā …pe… sattāgārikā vā honti sattālopikā
mn36:5.7: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpenti dvīhipi dattīhi yāpenti …pe… sattahipi dattīhi yāpenti

mn36:6.1: kiṃ pana te aggivessana tāvatakeneva yāpentīti.

mn36:6.4: te imaṃ kāyaṃ balaṃ gāhenti nāma brūhenti nāma medenti nāmāti.
mn36:6.5: yaṃ kho te aggivessana purimaṃ pahāya pacchā upacinanti evaṃ imassa kāyassa ācayāpacayo hoti.
mn36:6.6: kinti pana te aggivessana cittabhāvanā sutāti.
mn36:6.7: cittabhāvanāya saccako niganthaputto bhagavatā puṭṭho samāno na sampāyāsi.
mn36:7.1: atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ niganthaputtaṃ etadavoca
mn36:7.2: yāpi kho te esā aggivessana purimā kāyabhāvanā bhāvitā sāpi ariyassa vinaye no dhammikā kāyabhāvanā
mn36:7.3: kāyabhāvanampi kho tvaṃ aggivessana na aññāsi kuto pana tvaṃ cittabhāvanaṃ jānissasi
mn36:7.4: apica aggivessana yathā abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto ca
mn36:7.6: evaṃ bhoti kho saccako niganthaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
mn36:8.1: kathañca aggivessana abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca.
mn36:8.2: idha aggivessana assutavato puthujjanassa uppajjati sukhā vedanā
mn36:8.3: so sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno sukhasārāgī ca hoti sukhasārāgitaṃ ca āpajjati
mn36:8.5: sukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati dukkhā vedanā
mn36:8.6: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati
mn36:8.7: tassa kho esā aggivessana uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa
mn36:8.8: yassakassaci aggivessana evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa evaṃ kho aggivessana abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca.

mn36:9.2: idha aggivessana sutavato ariyasāvakassa uppajjati sukhā vedanā
mn36:9.3: so sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na sukhasārāgī hoti na sukhasārāgitaṃ āpajjati
mn36:9.5: sukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati dakkhā vedanā

mn36:9.7: tassa kho evaṃ sā aggivessana uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā cittassa
mn36:9.8: yassakassaci aggivessana ubhatopakkhaṃ 2 uppannāpi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā kāyassa uppannāpi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā cittassa evaṃ kho aggivessana bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto cāti.
mn36:10.2: bhavaṃ hi gotamo bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto cāti.
mn36:10.3: addhā kho te ayaṃ aggivessana āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā
mn36:10.5: yato kho ahaṃ aggivessana kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito taṃ vata me uppannā vā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati uppannā vā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
mn36:11.1: naha nūna bhoto gotamassa uppajjati tathārūpā sukhā vedanā yathārūpā uppannā sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭheyya naha nūna bhoto gotamassa uppajjati tathārūpā dukkhā vedanā yathārūpā uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭheyyāti.
mn36:12.2: idha aggivessana pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
mn36:12.4: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ
mn36:12.5: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
mn36:13.1: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rodantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn36:13.2: so pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn36:13.3: icchāmahaṃ āvuso kālāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
mn36:13.4: evaṃ vutte aggivessana āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca
mn36:13.6: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
mn36:13.7: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn36:13.8: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca pajānāmi passāmīti ca paṭijānāmi ahañceva aññe ca.
mn36:13.10: na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti
mn36:13.11: addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatīti.
mn36:13.12: atha kho ahaṃ aggivessana yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn36:13.13: kittāvatā no āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn36:13.14: evaṃ vutte aggivessana āḷāro kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn36:13.16: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā mayhaṃpatthi saddhā
mn36:13.17: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi viriyaṃ mayhaṃpatthi viriyaṃ
mn36:13.18: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi sati mayhaṃpatthi sati
mn36:13.19: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi samādhi mayhaṃpatthi samādhi
mn36:13.20: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi paññā mayhaṃpatthi paññā
mn36:13.21: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ āḷāro kālāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyanti.
mn36:13.22: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn36:14.1: atha khvāhaṃ aggivessana yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ
mn36:14.2: ettāvatā no āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn36:14.3: ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemīti.
mn36:14.4: ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti.
mn36:14.5: lābhā no āvuso suladdhaṃ no āvuso
mn36:14.6: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma
mn36:14.7: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi
mn36:14.8: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi tamahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi
mn36:14.9: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi tamahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi
mn36:14.10: iti yādiso ahaṃ tādiso tuvaṃ yādiso tuvaṃ tādiso ahaṃ
mn36:14.11: ehidāni āvuso ubho vasantā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmāti.
mn36:14.12: iti kho aggivessana āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attano samasamaṃ ṭhapesi uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.

mn36:14.15: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.

mn36:16.2: tatthaddasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ pāsādikañca vanasaṇḍaṃ nadiñca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ samantā gocaragāmaṃ.
mn36:16.4: ramaṇīyo vata bho bhūmibhāgo pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā samantā gocaragāmo.
mn36:16.6: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tattheva nisīdiṃ
mn36:17.1: apissu maṃ aggivessana tisso upamā paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
mn36:17.2: seyyathāpi aggivessana allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ.
mn36:17.6: api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimatthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya tejo pātukareyyāti.
mn36:17.9: aduñhi bho gotama allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ tañca pana udake nikkhittaṃ
mn36:17.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti
mn36:17.11: evameva kho aggivessana ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva kāmehi avūpakaṭṭhā viharanti yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmachando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho so ca ajjhattaṃ na supahīno hoti na supaṭippassaddho. opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tippā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

mn36:27.4: mā kho tvaṃ mārisa sabbaso āhārupacchedāya paṭipajji
mn36:27.5: sace kho tvaṃ mārisa sabbaso āhārupacchedāya paṭipajjissasi tassa te mayaṃ dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhoharissāma tāya tvaṃ yāpessasīti.
mn36:27.7: ahañceva kho pana sabbaso jaddhukaṃ paṭijāneyyaṃ imā ca me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohareyyuṃ tāya cāhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ taṃ mama assa musāti.
mn36:27.8: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tā devatā paccācikkhāmi alanti vadāmi.
mn36:28.2: yannūnāhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsanti.
mn36:28.3: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
mn36:28.4: tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ patto me kāyo hoti.
mn36:28.5: seyyathāpi nāma asītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.6: seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.7: seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvallī evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako uṇṇatāvaṇato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.8: seyyathāpi nāma jarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti evamevassu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.9: seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti evamevassu me akkhikūpe akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.10: seyyathāpi nāma tittikālābu āmakacchinno vātātapena saṃphusito hoti sammilāto evamevassu me sīse sīsacchavī saṃphusitā hoti sammilātā tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.11: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana udaracchaviṃ parimasissāmīti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmīti udaracchaviṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi yāvassu me aggivessana udaracchavī piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.12: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmīti tattheva avakujjo papatāmi tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn36:28.13: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana imameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi tassa mayhaṃ aggivessana pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāyevappāhāratāya.

mn36:45.4: na kho panetaṃ aggivessana evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
mn36:45.5: yāvadeva viññāpanatthāya tathāgato sammadeva tesaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti.
mn36:45.6: so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tassāyeva gāthāya pariyosāne tasmiṃyeva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisīdāmi samādahāmi ekodiṃ karomi yena sudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmīti.
mn36:45.7: okappaniyametaṃ bhoto gotamassa yathātaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
mn36:45.8: abhijānāti kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo divā supitāti.
mn36:46.1: abhijānāmahaṃ aggivessana gimhānaṃ pacchime māse pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto catuguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sato sampajāno niddaṃ okkamitāti.
mn36:46.2: etaṃ kho bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammohavihārasmiṃ vadantīti.
mn36:46.3: na kho aggivessana ettāvatā sammūḷho vā hoti asammūḷho vā
mn36:46.4: apica aggivessana yathā sammūḷho vā hoti asammūḷho vā
mn36:46.6: evaṃ bhoti kho saccako niganthaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
mn36:47.1: kathañca aggivessana sammūḷho hoti yassakassaci aggivessana ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā appahīnā tamahaṃ sammūḷhoti vadāmi
mn36:47.2: āsavānaṃ hi aggivessana appahānā sammūḷho hoti.
mn36:47.3: yassakassaci aggivessana ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā pahīnā tamahaṃ asammūḷhoti vadāmi
mn36:47.4: āsavānaṃ hi aggivessana pahānā asammūḷho hoti.
mn36:47.5: tathāgatassa kho aggivessana ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn36:47.6: seyyathāpi nāma aggivessana tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna virūḷhiyā
mn36:47.7: evameva kho aggivessana tathāgatassa ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāti.
mn36:48.1: evaṃ vutte saccako niganthaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn36:48.2: acchariyaṃ bho gotama abbhūtaṃ bho gotama
mn36:48.3: yāvañcīdaṃ bhoto gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa upanītehi vacanapathehi samudācariyamānassa chavivaṇṇo ceva pariyodāyati mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati yathātaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
mn36:48.4: abhijānāmahaṃ bho gotama pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā
mn36:48.5: sopi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññenaññaṃ paṭicari bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsi
mn36:48.6: bhoto pana gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa upanītehi vacanapathehi samudācariyamānassa chavivaṇṇo ceva pariyodāyati mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati yathātaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
mn36:48.12: sopi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññenaññaṃ paṭicari bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsi
mn36:48.13: bhoto pana gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa upanītehi vacanapathehi samudācariyamānassa chavivaṇṇo ceva pariyodāyati mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati yathātaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
mn36:48.14: handa cadāni mayaṃ bho gotama gacchāma
